resources.string: omakey works offline. It sends no typed text anywhere, and includes no analytics or ad SDKs. Your personal dictionary, clipboard history, and theme choices are stored only on this device. Two things use the network, and only these: checking for app updates (the button below, or automatically every 12 hours if \"Automatic update checks\" is on — it is by default), and downloading language packs, which happens only when you tap \"Get more languages\" and choose one in Settings → Languages. Both talk only to omakey\'s GitHub releases, and neither sends any typed text or other data.
